messages:
rana: quick sync after the SEC postmortem. two main follow-ups: (1) audit-log gaps during bulk token rotates, (2) TTL unit inconsistencies after migration. need concrete owners, a short emergency playbook, and a compliance artifact checklist.

diego: i'll take audit gap ownership. observed that the rotate tool with `--fast` skips audit middleware. plan: force audit-write in middleware and add a preflight that blocks `--fast` in prod. will open PR and a rollout canary.

mira: i'll own TTL normalization in the writer lib. will enforce seconds-only, add guardrails rejecting TTLs outside [10s, 30d], and ship an integration test that simulates mixed-binary writes. feature flag `AUTH_TTL_ENFORCE` will gate rollout. target: PR by 2026-04-02.

ops-oncall: drafting a 6-step emergency rotate playbook: 1) run audit export to CSV; 2) group by service owner; 3) if affected_count > 2000 -> automated rotate with 24h grace; else targeted manual rotate; 4) enable strict validation in canary; 5) verify audit events for every rotated token; 6) store proof artifacts to secure storage and link to ticket. prepping a 30m prep call tomorrow 09:00 PT.

diego: sample audit command I'm testing (batched):
```
redis-cli --scan --pattern "auth:token:*" \| while read k; do t=$(redis-cli ttl "$k"); if [ "$t" -le 10 -o "$t" -gt 2592000 ]; then echo "$k,$t"; fi; done > anomalies.csv
```
I'll optimize for scale and post in SEC-5001.

mira: opened runtime PR https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/3801 — includes TTL normalization and a migration integration test harness. added CI check `ci/ttl-unit`.

rana: owners + deadlines:
- MIRA: merge TTL normalization + tests (due 2026-04-02)
- DIEGO: audit script + enforced middleware + alerting (due 2026-03-31)
- OPS-ONCALL: runbook + prep call + 6-week follow-ups (prep call 2026-03-27)

compliance-bot: compliance checklist updated: must attach audit CSV + proof artifacts to SEC ticket before closing (automated).

rana: final notes: keep ticket SEC-5001 updated for status changes. one-week post-rotation review scheduled 2026-04-10 to capture any auth regressions. mark updates done in thread once runbook and proofs are attached. thanks.
